features.definition: Primary body color is blue or blue-gray (0=not blue, 1=predominantly blue)
Primary body color is green (0=not green, 1=predominantly green)
Primary body color is brown, tan, or beige (0=not brown/tan, 1=predominantly brown/tan)
Primary body color is red or orange (0=not red/orange, 1=predominantly red/orange)
Primary body color is dark gray, black, or very dark (0=not dark, 1=predominantly dark)
Stands upright on two legs in a humanoid posture (1=yes, 0=no)
Has four legs and walks on all fours like a typical animal (1=yes, 0=no)
Body is elongated, snake-like, or worm-like without prominent limbs (1=yes, 0=no)
Resembles a bird with wings and beak (1=yes, 0=no)
Body is blob-like, gelatinous, or lacks a defined solid form (1=yes, 0=no)
Resembles an insect or arthropod with multiple legs/antennae (1=yes, 0=no)
Has visible plant features like leaves, vines, flowers, or grass (1=yes, 0=no)
Has mechanical, metallic, or robotic appearance with hard armor-like plating (1=yes, 0=no)
Has a clearly visible tail (1=yes, 0=no)
Has visible wings or wing-like appendages (1=yes, 0=no)
Has prominent spikes or spines on the body (1=yes, 0=no)
Appears to be a large or powerful Pokémon based on visual bulk and complexity (0=small/simple, 1=large/complex)
Has a cute, friendly, or non-threatening appearance with round features (0=intimidating/aggressive, 1=very cute/friendly)
Resembles a dragon or reptile with scales and dinosaur-like features (1=yes, 0=no)
Resembles a mammal (dog, cat, bear, primate, etc.) (1=yes, 0=no)
Has features associated with water/aquatic life (fins, flippers, gills, water droplets) (1=yes, 0=no)
Has a ghostly, ethereal, or spectral appearance (semi-transparent, floating, wispy) (1=yes, 0=no)
Image shows more than one creature/entity that form a single Pokémon or pair (1=yes, 0=no)
Has very large or prominently featured eyes relative to body (0=small/normal eyes, 1=extremely large/prominent eyes)
Overall visual complexity and detail level (0=very simple/minimal design, 1=highly complex/detailed design)

The Pokémon has a natural, organic appearance dominated by earth tones (brown, tan, beige) or plant/wood materials, without prominent blue, metallic, or high-tech elements (0=not natural/earthy, 1=strongly natural/earthy organic appearance)
The Pokémon's primary or secondary color scheme is blue, dark gray, or black, giving it a cool or shadowy appearance (0=no blue/dark dominance, 1=strongly blue or dark colored)

notes: The user seems to be grouping by Pokémon type, particularly separating Normal/Grass types (brown/tan, non-threatening, non-dragon) from Water/Dragon/Fighting/Steel types (blue, dark, mechanical, aggressive). item_033 (Yungoos - Normal), item_019 (Bonsly - Normal/Rock), and item_051 (Trevenant - Ghost/Grass) share brown/tan coloring, small-medium size, and non-blue, non-dark, non-mechanical appearance. The key distinguishing feature seems to be: brown/tan dominant + NOT blue/dark/mechanical. Need to heavily weight brown_tan and reduce blue/dark features, and add a feature for 'non-threatening normal-type appearance'.
